hideFailed: Could not hide Panora. Use Omarchy’s Plugins settings to disable it.
previewDescription: Preview of the last accepted image; not a measurement of the desktop
executableNotice: Set the widget’s executable to an absolute Panora CLI path in Omarchy’s shell.json.
setup: Add a source in Panora to begin
warning: A source or playback action needs attention. Local and cached images may remain usable. Open Panora for details.

actionUnconfirmed: The action result was not confirmed. Check status before trying again. It will not be retried automatically.
